children.text: You have no tickets yet. Press NEW TICKET, or type /ticket your message in chat.
Your position is saved with the ticket so staff can find the place you mean. Staff can change the category if it was guessed wrong.

Search idea or player, press Enter

children.text: Ideas players send will be pinned up on this board.
SET A DECISION (THE PLAYER IS TOLD IN CHAT)
Setting **Declined** or **Done** closes the idea for new player messages. Write a reply first so the player knows why.
You have not sent an idea yet. Press NEW SUGGESTION and tell us what would make the server better.
Share an idea for the server. Staff read every one and tell you what they decide. Please keep it to one idea per suggestion.

children.hint: Example: Sell Great Balls at the Pokecenter
Describe your idea and why it would help...

children.text: You have not reported anyone. Use the form to tell staff about a player who broke a rule.
Only report rule-breaking such as griefing, cheating, harassment or spam. Staff also see where you are standing when you send it. For problems that are not about a player, use **Help Tickets**.
